article.title: Carrick 'saddened' by Man Utd situation after Bournemouth loss
article.summary: Manchester United manager Micheal Carrick reflects on a 'tough day' after his side lost 3-0 at home to Bournemouth with his future in doubt with United without a win in their last eight games.
